insights.one_liner: Everience Benelux is part of an international IT consulting group focused on AI and data services, with a senior project role in Amsterdam.

culture.text: The group has about 4,000 people in France and worldwide; the Benelux branch, based in Brussels, shows 39 on LinkedIn.
Staff studied computer science, networking, business and economics at schools like Maastricht University and Université libre de Bruxelles.
Focuses on digital transformation, AI and data, with the idea of AI supporting employees rather than replacing them.

open.text: Not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one open job here, a senior project role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.
